title: Matrix with fractional and decimal entries (reciprocal handling)
description: A 3x3 matrix whose entries mix fraction strings (1/3, 1/7) and decimal values (2.5, and its reciprocal 0.4). It exercises an implementation's handling of non-integer judgments and of reciprocal pairs expressed in different notations. The matrix is mildly inconsistent (a13 = 2.5 while a12 * a23 = 7/3), so eigenvector and approximate methods differ slightly; expected values are derived.

scale.name: saaty-1-9
scale.notes: Judgments on Saaty's fundamental 1-9 scale; reciprocals (e.g. 1/3) and intermediate or fractional values are valid entries. Matrix entries may be given as numbers or as fraction strings such as "1/3".

Column-normalization mean (Saaty's approximate method): normalize each column of the matrix to sum to 1, then average across columns; lambda_max is estimated as the mean of (A*w)_i / w_i. This is the prioritization method implemented by, among others, the npm 'ahp' package. Reproduce with tools/compute_expected.py.
